title: Pinned Diner RC2 retains independently extracted write-door readiness evidence
steps: Run readiness judgement against the actual Diner pin and committed package-derived manifest, with missing and unread door negative controls.
expect: The pinned RC2 package is judged ready for all declared write doors.
A known older Diner plugin lacking the doors is held with the exact missing-door list.
Unread package or newly required evidence remains held rather than inferred ready.

tests: the T3 case: JA Diner j6 on plugin 0.24.80 lacked every write door; on its current pin 0.24.95-rc.2 it has them all
a pinned plugin the manifest has not read is not checked, which is never a pass
a door the write step adds is held to the plugin at once: not read in any package yet, it is never a pass
